retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sun-drenched portrait of two young protagonists with tall, condensed pink typography and a semi-transparent footer bar.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly tilted portrait of two smiling adolescents against a soft-focus green foliage background. The primary subject wears a distinctive patterned woven bucket hat. The layout features a large, vertically stretched title in the upper right and a semi-transparent blue-grey banner at the bottom containing white credits.
coreVisualRelationships: The tilted heads of the subjects create a dynamic diagonal line through the center.
The vibrant pink of the title contrasts with the natural greens and yellows of the background and hat.
The semi-transparent footer anchors the composition, providing a stable base for detailed text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in a medium close-up, filling the majority of the frame with a slight clockwise tilt.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The patterned woven hat on the left subject acts as the primary textural focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subjects' faces to the large title in the top right, then down to the credit banner at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily occupied by the blurred green foliage in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones and natural greens from the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant salmon-pink for the main title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High brightness with warm, golden-hour saturation levels.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or cold digital blues

letterConstructionRules: Title uses extremely high aspect ratio (vertically stretched).
Secondary text uses small caps or high-waisted serif forms.
Footer text is tightly tracked and centered.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The number '2' is stylized with a distinct curve and flat base to match the title height.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a modern condensed sans-serif for the title with a traditional, widely-spaced serif for credits.
graphicDevices: Semi-transparent blue-grey rectangular overlay at the bottom edge.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display title.
Classic serif feel for the credit block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, sunlit portrait of two smiling teenagers outdoors with a blurred green garden background. One should wear a colorful woven bucket hat. Leave the top right and bottom edge clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vertically stretched title in salmon-pink with a thin white outline in the top right. Add a semi-transparent blue-grey bar across the bottom with white serif text centered inside.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and natural?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the pink text is legible against the background.
Ensure the woven texture of the hat is visible.
Verify the footer bar does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Confirm the vertical stretch of the title is intentional and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Vertical Condensed Title + Transparent Credit Banner = 90s Soundtrack Aesthetic
